evals.prompt: 请把这篇文章改写成一篇中文博客并生成封面，然后发布到微信公众号草稿箱：https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents
evals.expected_output: 会先用可交互浏览器抓取完整正文并形成结构化笔记，再生成独立的中文 Markdown 博客。新封面默认使用 HD-2D，在 cover-brief.json 中记录风格描述、理由与最终 prompt；正文需要图解时通常添加 0–2 张同风格插图，保持像素尺度、配色和光影一致，不改变正文语气和事实。封面阶段读取 references/cover-prompt-template.md，最终封面保存到 src/assets/{ID}/01-cover.{ext}，并将 ogImage 与微信 cover-image 指向该路径；正文插图使用独立文件和 Markdown 引用。微信返回 media_id 后才提交推送本篇文章及资源。

assertions.text: Cover generation stays backend-agnostic by default instead of hardcoding a specific image-generation skill.
When no style is specified, new covers and generated inline illustrations use HD-2D: crisp pixel edges, 2D subjects in a 3D miniature diorama, soft lighting, and moderate depth of field.
The selected style is used for the cover brief, cover prompt, and cover acceptance, but does not affect article voice or facts.
The cover brief records `summary_angle`, `narrative_flow`, `information_blocks`, `selected_style`, `selected_style_prompt_descriptor`, `selected_style_reason`, and `style_safety_note`.
The final cover image is saved under `src/assets/{ID}/` rather than left in a generated-images temp/default directory.
`ogImage` and the WeChat `cover-image` parameter reference the final cover path.
After WeChat draft publishing succeeds and returns `media_id`, the workflow commits and pushes only the generated blog post and assets.

evals.prompt: 把这个产品发布页写成中文博客，封面用默认方式生成，不要做成产品截图：https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-image-2/
evals.expected_output: 会将文章识别为 release，按产品发布类型确定主体与构图，默认 selected_style 为 HD-2D，并在 prompt 中写入像素主体、三维微缩空间、柔和光影和适度景深。封面保持 2.35:1、一个主焦点与 2–4 个来源可追溯的信息块，默认只保留 1–3 处短标签或数字，禁止主标题、假 UI、假仪表盘、假图表和假终端。

assertions.text: The cover type is selected from the fixed taxonomy and is appropriate for a product/release article.
An unspecified release cover uses HD-2D while its subject and composition still follow the release type.
The selected style descriptor is included in the image prompt while the cover still follows infographic-story constraints.
The cover concept expresses the article theme without pretending to be a real product screenshot.

evals.prompt: 请用 Azure OpenAI 生成封面，把这篇英文教程改写成中文博客并推到微信草稿箱，封面用美漫超级英雄风：https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/openai/how-to/dall-e
evals.expected_output: 会尊重用户明确指定 Azure 和美漫超级英雄风的要求，在封面阶段使用 azure-image-gen，并将 selected_style 设为美漫超级英雄风，覆盖本次封面的 HD-2D 默认值。先生成 cover-brief.json，用具体的线条、色块和漫画质感描述构造 prompt。最终资源使用 jpg/png，工具输出其他格式时先转换，并将实际最终封面路径同步到 Markdown ogImage 和微信 cover-image。

assertions.text: An explicit Azure preference is honored for cover generation even though the default flow is backend-agnostic.
An explicit style request overrides the HD-2D default only for the images covered by that request.
The prompt describes the requested superhero-comic visual features without copying specific characters or franchise assets.
The final saved PNG or JPG path is authoritative; an unsupported intermediate format is converted before publishing.
The final image path is propagated consistently to blog frontmatter and WeChat publishing.
After WeChat draft publishing succeeds, the workflow reports `media_id`, commit hash, and pushed branch.

evals.prompt: 把这篇架构文章写成中文博客。封面可以参考正文里的架构图，但不能照抄，也不能生成假的架构标签：https://example.com/agent-workflow-architecture
evals.expected_output: 会将文章识别为 architecture，默认使用 HD-2D，以三维微缩模块场景和二维像素主体表达关系。封面保持一个主焦点与 2–4 个来源明确的信息块。参考图仅帮助理解主体关系和空间结构，真实架构图在正文保留原貌；生成图片禁止假架构节点名、假仪表盘、假图表坐标和截图式画面。

assertions.text: Reference images are used only for composition or subject relationships, not pixel-level copying.
Architecture covers default to HD-2D unless the user explicitly specifies another style for that image.
Architecture covers may show abstract connections and flow markers but must not create fake labeled system diagrams.
The prompt includes a clear avoid list for fake labels and screenshot-like artifacts.

evals.prompt: 只把这个链接写成博客，不要生成封面，也不要发微信：https://example.com/short-note
evals.expected_output: 会生成带 frontmatter、正文和参考链接的博客。不要封面只跳过封面生成、封面 brief 和 ogImage；正文仍按需要决定是否配图，该短文无额外解释需要时不添加插图。不发微信也跳过提交和推送。

assertions.text: The explicit no-cover request skips cover generation and the cover brief without prohibiting useful inline illustrations.
The explicit no-WeChat request prevents `wechat-draft` from being invoked.
The blog article is still generated normally without `ogImage`.
This short article receives no inline illustration when the text already explains the topic adequately.
The explicit no-WeChat request also skips the post-publish git commit and push flow.

evals.prompt: 把这篇观点文章改写成中文博客并生成封面：https://example.com/spec-driven-ai-opinion
evals.expected_output: 会将文章识别为 analysis，默认 selected_style 为 HD-2D，结合对照构图表达核心判断；封面保持单张宽图和至少两个可映射回原文的信息块，不使用泛技术氛围图。正文只有对比需要额外图解时才添加同风格插图。

assertions.text: When style is unspecified for an analysis article, the brief records HD-2D and its concrete visual descriptor.
The cover summary contains at least two article-grounded information blocks rather than a generic thematic illustration.
The prompt forbids poster titles, fake UI labels, fake chart axes, and fabricated metrics regardless of the selected style.

evals.prompt: 把这篇研究解读写成中文博客，封面指定新海诚光影风，并保留一两个关键数字：https://example.com/model-paper-breakdown
evals.expected_output: 会把文章识别为 `research`，并尊重用户明确指定的 `新海诚光影风`，把它记录为 `selected_style`。由于该名称强指向特定在世作者，最终 prompt 使用安全描述词，例如高透明天空、强逆光、细腻云层、青春电影感光影、雨水和反射细节，并在 `style_safety_note` 说明不复刻具体作者画风。封面仍保持单张宽图，只允许少量来源可追溯的中文短标签和关键数字，不能扩展成海报式长标题或伪造实验图表。

assertions.text: An explicit style request overrides the HD-2D default for the requested research cover.
`新海诚光影风` is preserved as `selected_style` but converted to a non-imitative `selected_style_prompt_descriptor`.
`style_safety_note` explains that strong brand/artist/studio style names are rewritten into safe descriptive terms.
Visible numbers on the cover must be sourced from the article or used as ordinal markers, not invented.
The prompt allows only a small amount of Chinese labels and key numbers while still forbidding long titles and fake charts.

evals.prompt: 把这篇技术教程改写成适合微信公众号发布的中文文章，并生成封面后发草稿箱：https://example.com/devtool-automation-guide
evals.expected_output: 会先完成公众号运营判断：该文服务 Aide Hub 的软件开发 / AI 助手定位，读者收益是学会一个可落地的方法，分发倾向偏收藏。正文仍保持教程写法，写清前提、步骤、结果验证和坑点；标题降低解释成本，使用技术对象加具体收益或适用场景；description 作为微信预览摘要控制在 80-120 字，并自然说明读者为什么值得点开。固定关注语默认省略；如果账号运营确实需要引导，只加入一句与本篇主题直接相关的话，并完成去 AI 味改稿。

assertions.text: The workflow performs a WeChat account-ops judgment before writing, including account positioning, reader takeaway, and distribution tendency.
The article title reduces explanation cost and combines a technical object with a concrete benefit or usage scenario.
The description is treated as a WeChat preview summary and stays useful without hype.
A fixed WeChat follow prompt is not required; any retained follow prompt is optional, topic-specific, and does not replace the article's concrete ending.
After a successful WeChat draft publish, the generated Markdown and article assets are committed and pushed.

evals.prompt: 把这篇工具评测写成博客并发布到公众号草稿箱。可以顺便给我一个自动回复关键词建议，但不要承诺没有准备好的资料：https://example.com/ai-code-review-tool
evals.expected_output: 会把文章识别为工具评测型，并判断其公众号分发倾向偏涨粉：重点写使用场景、替代方案、上手门槛和适用边界。可以在最终报告里给出自动回复关键词建议，例如“清单”或“工具”，但只有当正文实际产出了对应资源或用户提供了资源时，才把关键词和资源承诺写进文章。正文和文末引导不得承诺不存在的资料、源码、课程、社群、优惠或咨询服务。

assertions.text: Tool-review articles are guided toward scenarios, alternatives, onboarding cost, and boundaries rather than generic praise.
Keyword auto-reply suggestions may be reported separately without implying the account backend is configured.
The generated article does not promise resources, source code, courses, communities, discounts, or consulting that were not actually provided.
After WeChat draft publishing succeeds, git status is checked and only this article's files are staged before commit and push.

evals.prompt: 只把这篇趋势观点文章写成博客，不要发微信，也不要写成爆款公众号文：https://example.com/ai-agent-market-opinion
evals.expected_output: 会尊重用户明确的范围限制：只生成中文博客，不调用 `wechat-draft`。仍会做轻量公众号运营判断来确认文章更偏观点评论型、读者收益是形成判断、分发倾向偏转发，但不会强行加入公众号文末关注模块，也不会把观点文章包装成夸张爆款。标题、摘要和正文保持自然技术博客表达，保留原文判断依据和适用边界。

assertions.text: The explicit no-WeChat request prevents `wechat-draft` from being invoked and skips the WeChat follow module.
Opinion articles are not forced into hype-driven WeChat viral copy.
The article preserves source-grounded reasoning and boundaries instead of inventing claims.
The explicit no-WeChat request also prevents any post-publish git commit or push.

evals.prompt: 把这个只有标题和摘要、正文需要登录才能看的链接写成博客：https://example.com/members-only
evals.expected_output: 尝试浏览器交互和允许的公开来源后，如果仍无法取得完整正文，就停止成文，列出缺失内容，并请用户提供正文或可访问链接；不得根据标题、摘要或搜索片段补写文章，也不得进入封面、微信发布或 Git 推送。

assertions.text: Incomplete source access stops article generation instead of producing a best-effort article from fragments.
No cover, WeChat publish, commit, or push occurs after source completeness fails.

evals.prompt: 把这篇两年前的 API 教程改写成中文博客，原文使用的接口版本可能已经变化：https://example.com/old-api-guide
evals.expected_output: 完整读取原文后，继续用最新官方文档核对接口版本、参数、兼容性和示例。若原文已过期，正文采用当前官方信息，并简短说明原文当时的做法；保留可追溯来源，不把旧命令当成当前有效步骤。

assertions.text: Drift-prone technical claims are checked against current primary official documentation.
Current official behavior governs the article while historical source context is stated briefly.

evals.prompt: 把这个教程写成博客、生成封面并自动发布：https://example.com/tutorial-with-missing-image
evals.expected_output: 生成文章和资源后先完成发布前内容审查，再运行 Prettier 与 validate-article.mjs --wechat。若核心结论、文章新增价值、章节主线或结尾未通过内容审查，先修改文章；来源不足导致无法修正时保留本地文件并停止后续流程。若 frontmatter、标题摘要、封面 brief 或本地资源路径校验失败，同样保留本地文件并停止微信发布、Git 提交和推送。

assertions.text: Validation runs before WeChat publishing.
A qualitative content review runs before formatting and structural validation, and an unresolved content-review failure blocks WeChat publishing, commit, and push.
A validation failure prevents WeChat publishing, commit, and push while preserving generated local files.

evals.prompt: 只把这篇技术教程生成一篇完整中文博客 Markdown，不要生成封面、不要发微信，也不要用执行计划代替文章：https://www.devleader.ca/2026/08/24/hybrid-search-for-rag-in-net-bm25-vectors-and-reciprocal-rank-fusion
evals.expected_output: 直接生成带 frontmatter、完整正文和参考链接的 Markdown 文件。开头从精确词匹配与概念匹配不能互相覆盖的检索问题进入，尽早给出混合查询的目标结果和最短可行代码路径，再逐步解释 BM25、向量检索、RRF 与排错边界。文章应增加当前官方资料核对、可运行示例或排错判断等明确价值，删去重复定义，结尾给出读者可以执行的检索检查步骤。

assertions.text: The result is a complete Markdown article artifact with frontmatter, substantive body, and references rather than a plan or workflow description.
The opening enters a concrete hybrid-search problem quickly and does not default to a source-attribution plus `本文/适合/读完` template.
The tutorial shows the target result and a minimal workable query path before deeper implementation detail.
The article adds verifiable value such as current official API checks, runnable code, or a retrieval-versus-generation troubleshooting boundary.
Sections form a progressive explanation without repeating the same BM25, vector, or RRF definitions, and the ending gives a concrete next step.

evals.prompt: 把这篇工程师成长观点文章写成一篇完整中文博客 Markdown，只生成博客，不要封面、微信发布或执行计划：https://lalitm.com/post/find-problems-staff-engineer/
evals.expected_output: 从 Senior 工程师找不到值得投入的问题这一具体困境进入，尽早给出核心判断：好问题来自持续接触真实工作、积累重复信号和投入前验证。正文保留失败案例、方法边界和可执行动作，避免扩写成泛泛的职场建议；结尾给出读者下周可以尝试的观察或验证动作。

assertions.text: The result is a complete Markdown article artifact, not an outline or a description of how the article would be written.
The opening uses the reader's concrete Staff-level problem and states the article's thesis early.
The article preserves source-grounded failures, counterexamples, and organizational limits instead of inflating the source into generic career advice.
Each major section advances the decision process from observing signals through validation, and redundant summaries are removed.
The ending gives a specific observation or validation action and does not rely on a generic Aide Hub follow sentence.

evals.prompt: 把这篇长篇研究论文解读成一篇完整中文博客 Markdown，只生成博客，不要封面、微信发布或执行计划：https://arxiv.org/html/2601.20245v2
evals.expected_output: 开头先给出研究问题、实验对象和最重要发现，再解释实验设计、交互模式、结果与限制。正文区分论文证据、作者解释和文章给开发者的实践建议，不按论文目录逐节翻译；对于统计数字保留来源和条件，结尾说明在需要学习新技能的任务中应如何安排 AI 使用方式。

assertions.text: The result is a complete Markdown research article with frontmatter, body, and references rather than a plan.
The opening presents the research question, experimental population, and main finding before extended background.
The article clearly separates reported evidence, source-author interpretation, and the blog's practical implications.
Long source material is prioritized around the central finding and limitations instead of being translated section by section.
All quantitative claims retain their conditions and sources, and the ending offers a bounded decision for AI-assisted learning.

evals.prompt: 把这个产品发布页写成一篇完整、简洁的中文博客 Markdown，只生成博客，不要封面、微信发布或执行计划：https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-image-2/
evals.expected_output: 直接生成完整 Markdown。开头用最影响使用者的变化或结果进入，正文围绕变化、适合谁、使用价值和限制组织，帮助读者判断是否值得尝试。发布页信息较短时保持克制，不为增加篇幅补写通用背景；结尾给出清晰的尝试条件或观察点。

assertions.text: The result is a complete concise Markdown article artifact rather than a workflow description.
The opening starts with the most consequential product change or outcome instead of generic AI-image background.
The structure helps a reader decide whether to try the release by covering changes, target users, practical value, and limits.
A short source remains a short article and is not padded with unsupported history, broad trend commentary, or repeated summaries.
The ending gives a concrete trial condition or observation point without a generic follow call.

evals.prompt: 把这个链接写成完整中文博客，只生成博客，不要封面和微信发布：https://artandbiz.substack.com/p/the-right-way-to-write-with-ai
evals.expected_output: 完整读取原文后直接生成带 frontmatter、正文和参考的中文解读，不要求用户补充个人经历。通过解释素材质量与写作结果的关系、区分事实和作者判断、说明适用条件增加价值，保留必要基础解释，不虚构用户亲历或实测，也不把原作者的代笔经历改成用户经历。

assertions.text: Given complete source access, the output is a complete Markdown article rather than an interview, outline, or execution plan.
The article adds grounded explanation or decision criteria beyond synonym substitution while retaining necessary introductory explanations.
Source-author experiences remain attributed to the source author; no user biography, personal test, or user opinion is invented.

evals.prompt: 把这篇文章写成中文博客，只生成博客，不要封面和微信发布：https://artandbiz.substack.com/p/the-right-way-to-write-with-ai 。加入我的经历和不同意见：上个月我给两位新同事写过部署说明，第一版加入了我排查故障的故事。他们反馈只想先知道命令和回滚步骤，我就把故事移到后面。我没有统计阅读时长。我认为操作教程应该先让读者完成任务，个人故事按需保留。
evals.expected_output: 生成完整文章，准确保留两位新同事、故事后移及未统计阅读时长的边界。呈现用户对操作教程的判断与原文强调个人素材的观点之间的区别，不把用户改写为全面赞同原文，也不推断阅读效率提升的数字。

assertions.text: The article preserves the supplied situation, reader feedback, decision to move the story, and absence of reading-time measurements without requesting those details again.
The user's task-first view remains distinct from the source author's emphasis on personal material, without being rewritten into agreement or generalized to every article.
No quantitative outcome, additional personal history, or universal causal claim is fabricated from the anecdote.

evals.prompt: 用我做技术写作的亲身经历来写这篇文章，写得像我的亲笔文章。只生成博客，不要封面和微信发布：https://artandbiz.substack.com/p/the-right-way-to-write-with-ai 。我还没有提供经历或本人写作样本。
evals.expected_output: 可先完成原文取证，但在成文前集中提出最多三个具体问题，收集与技术写作有关的情境与选择、实际结果与判断，以及本人写作样本。等待必要材料后再写，不根据账号定位或普通历史转载推断用户人生经历和声音，不生成带虚构亲历的正文。

assertions.text: The response asks at most three concrete questions in one batch focused on missing personal experience, outcome or stance, and a writing sample.
The workflow waits for required personal material before drafting and does not fabricate a first-person article or fill it with invented autobiographical placeholders.
Account positioning and ordinary historical reposts are not treated as evidence of the user's experiences, opinions, or personal voice.

evals.prompt: 把这篇文章写成完整中文博客，只生成博客，不要封面和微信发布：https://artandbiz.substack.com/p/the-right-way-to-write-with-ai 。请参考我亲笔写的表达样本：『先把输入看清楚。输出跑偏时，我会回去找缺了什么条件。日志只能说明发生了什么，原因还要验证。遇到不确定的地方，就写清楚不确定。』只参考表达方式，不把样本情境当成本篇事实，也不需要额外加入我的经历。
evals.expected_output: 直接生成完整文章，体现样本的直接用词、短句节奏和先观察再判断的解释方式，避免机械重复原句。保留原文证据归属、必要概念解释和适用条件，不凭样本编造用户使用某工具或做过某项测试的经历。

assertions.text: The complete article reflects the supplied sample's direct vocabulary, sentence rhythm, and evidence-before-conclusion explanations without mechanically repeating its phrases.
Style adaptation retains necessary conceptual or technical explanations and the article's source attribution and uncertainty boundaries.
The sample is used for expression only, not as evidence of current article facts or additional user experiences, and no unnecessary interview is introduced.

evals.prompt: 只想把这篇发布页写成自然、具体的中文博客，不要封面、微信发布或执行计划：https://openai.com/index/decisions-api/
evals.expected_output: 完整读取原文和必要官方文档后直接生成 Markdown。起草前参考仓库里的中文写作样本，初稿后依次完成内容编辑、文字编辑和独立的去 AI 味改稿。开头从具体工单或有限答案问题进入，不出现“这篇文章会说明”“读完后你能”等固定模板；小标题写本篇对象，清理重复过渡和总结，不机械堆三项列表，结尾落在具体行动或风险边界，并省略固定关注语。技术事实和来源归属保持不变。

assertions.text: The workflow reads the repository style samples and the de-AI editing guide before drafting.
The article is complete Markdown rather than an outline, workflow description, cover request, or WeChat publishing flow.
The opening uses a concrete bounded-decision scenario and does not use a fixed meta opening such as 'this article will explain' or 'after reading you can'.
The final pass removes generic headings, announcement-only first sentences, repeated transitions, mechanical three-item symmetry, and any fixed Aide Hub follow sentence.
The rewrite preserves source facts, code examples, uncertainty, and practical boundaries instead of inventing personal experience or test results.

evals.prompt: 把这篇流程讲解写成博客，只生成博客。复杂的任务交接部分可以适当加图：https://example.com/task-handoff-explainer
evals.expected_output: 默认生成 HD-2D 封面，评估任务交接段落确有解释需要后，在对应说明之后添加通常 1–2 张 16:9 同风格概念插图。每张有明确解释目标和来源锚点，与封面的配色、像素尺度和光影一致，保留文字说明。插图保存到文章资源目录并补中文 alt，不发布微信、不提交推送。

assertions.text: Inline illustrations are added only where a flow, mechanism, change, or comparison benefits from visual explanation, usually zero to two per article.
Each inline illustration addresses one explanation goal tied to a source anchor and appears near the relevant paragraph without splitting code or numbered steps.
Generated inline images default to 16:9 and match the cover in palette, pixel scale, lighting, and visual style.
Final PNG or JPG inline assets use distinct numbered illustration filenames and relative Markdown references with Chinese alt text; only the cover is used for ogImage.

evals.prompt: 把这篇只有一个简单结论的短文写成博客，生成封面即可，不发微信：https://example.com/simple-short-note
evals.expected_output: 生成完整短文和默认 HD-2D 封面。正文已能充分表达结论时不添加插图，不为凑数量或章节配图而生成图片。

assertions.text: A short article with sufficient textual explanation receives zero inline illustrations.
The default cover uses HD-2D and does not trigger a mandatory inline-image quota.

evals.prompt: 把这篇教程写成博客，不发微信，保留真实操作截图、架构图和实验结果图；难懂的机制可以加插图：https://example.com/tutorial-with-evidence-images
evals.expected_output: 保留真实操作截图、准确架构图和实验数据图原貌与来源，只有机制确需说明时另加 HD-2D 概念插图，注明概念示意。生成图不得取代真实证据或编造实验指标、界面、终端输出和节点名。

assertions.text: Real screenshots, accurate technical diagrams, and experiment charts remain unstyled evidence images.
Any HD-2D illustration supplements the mechanism explanation and is identified as conceptual when needed.
Generated visuals do not invent interfaces, commands or outputs, metrics, chart axes, or technical labels.

evals.prompt: 把这个链接写成博客，不要配图，不发微信：https://example.com/text-only-article
evals.expected_output: 生成完整 Markdown，不调用任何图片生成或编辑技能，不生成封面、正文插图、封面 brief 或 ogImage。已有真实截图和技术图仍按内容需要保留，不发布微信、不提交推送。

assertions.text: An explicit no-images request skips all cover and inline image generation and editing.
No cover brief or ogImage is created, while useful existing evidence images may be retained.
The complete article and references are still produced without WeChat, commit, or push.

evals.prompt: 把这篇机制讲解写成博客，不要封面，不发微信；正文机制部分请加一张 HD-2D 概念插图：https://example.com/mechanism-explainer
evals.expected_output: 跳过封面、封面 brief 和 ogImage，独立生成一张解释机制的 16:9 HD-2D 正文插图。先确定配色、像素尺度和光影，记录本图解释目标、来源依据和 prompt，保存到文章资源目录，使用中文 alt 与相对路径引用。

assertions.text: No-cover skips only the cover, cover brief, and ogImage while allowing the requested inline image.
An inline image can be planned and generated without a cover or a cover brief.
The standalone inline illustration uses the HD-2D descriptor, 16:9 composition, a valid local reference, and Chinese alt text.

evals.prompt: 把这篇工具流程文章写成博客，正文可按需加图，只生成博客：https://example.com/optional-inline-image-failure
evals.expected_output: 在可选正文插图生成失败或针对明确问题精修后仍不合格时，省略该图并删除对应 Markdown 引用，保留能独立阅读的完整正文，在最终报告说明失败或省略原因。封面失败按既有封面与发布规则处理，不能混同为可选插图失败。

assertions.text: An optional inline image that fails generation or remains unsuitable after targeted correction is omitted and its Markdown reference removed.
The complete article remains understandable without the omitted illustration and the final report explains the omission.
Optional inline failure handling does not bypass existing required-cover or publication validation.

evals.prompt: 把这篇架构文章写成博客，不发微信。封面指定水彩风，正文机制部分加一张默认风格插图：https://example.com/scoped-style-override
evals.expected_output: 封面遵从水彩风要求并记录对应风格描述与理由；覆盖范围仅限封面，正文插图仍为默认 HD-2D，并按单图明确指定风格的例外处理。两张图都保持来源真实、主体关系可读，历史文章和 brief 不迁移。

assertions.text: An explicit cover-only style override applies to the cover while the inline illustration retains the HD-2D default.
The brief preserves existing selected_style and descriptor fields and records the override reason.
Changing defaults does not rewrite historical articles, images, or briefs.
